decisions.reason: Requiring both stations to operate simultaneously does not change the required mixing quality, foam outcome, whisk selection, or whisk positioning.
The source requires dispensing from both spouts but does not require simultaneous dispensing or change the existing per-station dispensing controls, sequence, or flow behavior.
Several minutes of operation is a demonstration condition and does not alter the existing prolonged-use or maximum-speed duty constraints.
The existing message-238 MODIFY already records both stations running simultaneously and the other required demonstration elements.
Showing that speed adjustment functions does not change the existing speed range, maximum speed, or intended speed modes.
Simultaneous station operation does not change whisk removability, detachment behavior, clearance, or cleaning requirements.
The simultaneous-operation requirement does not change bowl capacity, depth, enclosure constraints, or geometry.
The source decision does not change bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
The source does not introduce or modify any splash-control target or mitigation method.
The existing state already requires capacity for both motors, solenoids, and cooling fans operating simultaneously, so no state change is necessary.
The existing message-238 MODIFY already records leak-free operation through both plumbing paths for several minutes; the simultaneous mixing-station decision adds no further plumbing change.
Simultaneous operation of the mixing stations does not change the deferred accent-lighting requirement.
